text: The authors state they do not address the preference payload: whose preferences the agent should be aligned to, how to aggregate and trade off different users' preferences, or when the agent should be disobedient. They treat these as out of scope and restrict the paper to a technical treatment of aligning a single agent to a single user.
title: Scope excludes the preference payload; one agent aligned to one user
